shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials and ability AI.

## Status
- Phase 1 (tested): traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- Visuals (tested): overlays, effecters (Flaming = tint + embers + light).
- Phase 2 materials (tested run #28).
- Light (tested run #29; default follow 1 cell).
- Mod settings (tested run #30 as columns; build 29 switched to tabs, not yet seen in game). User preference: settings pages use tabs (lore saved).
- **Phase 3, step 1: ability AI (builds 30–32, reviewed, not yet tested in game).**
- Phase 3 remaining: hide hidden traits in UI (stat explanations, ability gizmos), Biotech humanlike birth inheritance, diet traits, optional VRE gene compat.

## Ability AI (JobGiver_TitanAbilities, Source/TitanAI.cs)
- Postfix on Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob: when the constant tree gave no job and the pawn is a titan, run our job giver (every 30 ticks, can interrupt the current job, same slot as mech smokepop). Result is recorded against the constant tree root so saved mid-cast jobs load cleanly. Wrapped in try/catch (ErrorOnce per race).
- Races with no constant think tree get no ability AI (e.g. mechs without Biotech).
- Guards: spawned, awake, not downed/burning/drafted, not a player colonist, not in a non-aggro mental state (manhunters cast), not already casting, not full-body busy. Setting `abilityAI` (Traits tab) turns it off.
- Order: 1) each trait's `aiThinkTree` (ThinkTreeDef, free-form, any conditions, in or out of combat); 2) combat only: offensive trait abilities at the current enemy (enemyTarget, attack job target, or melee threat; must be hostile or the melee threat), vanilla GetAbilityJob style incl. AOE target and own-cell gate; 3) combat only: self-targeted non-offensive trait abilities.
- All casting still goes through vanilla Ability.AICanTargetNow: aiCanUse, cooldown, comps' AI checks.
- Tamed animals and player mechs cast on their own (they can't be ordered). Colonists use gizmos.
- Only abilities granted by titan traits are considered by the built-in steps.

## Mod settings (TitanSettings, `TitanFrameworkMod.Settings`)
Tabs: Lights and effects / Traits / Materials, reset button bottom right (Entad Framework pattern).
- Lights and effects: lightsEnabled, lightFollowCells 1–5 (1), lightRadiusFactor 25–200%, effectsEnabled.
- Traits: inheritChanceFactor 0–200%, discoveryMessages, abilityAI.
- Materials: materialArmorFactor 0–150% (50%), materialDamageStrength 0–200%, fireWeaknessStrength 0–200% (fire factor = 1 + (flam − 0.5) × s), butcherYieldPerBodySize 0–200 (40), smallVolumeMultiplier 1–20 (10), materialMarketValue.
- On window close every titan gets SettingsChanged(): effecters, light, material stage rebuilt.

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- Generation: commonality, pointCost, exclusionTags, tags, race filters (allowAnimals/Humanlikes/Mechanoids/Other, requiresFlesh, disallowConstructs, min/maxBodySize, allowedRaces, disallowedRaces).
- Discovery: visible, discoverWhen (Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies), discoveryMessage.
- Naming: namePrefix, nameSuffix, nameOrder.
- Inheritance: heritable, inheritChance (× setting).
- Effects: stage, hediffs, abilities, aiThinkTree, traitClass.
- Visuals: overlays, flames, effecters, scaleEffectersWithBodySize, showVisualsWhenHidden, glow.

## Visuals
- Overlays (glow shader redraw), flames (PostDraw sprites), DynamicPawnRenderNodeSetup, no Harmony.
- Effecters ticked by a MapComponent, built with zero offset + Trigger (SpawnAttached offset bug). Off with effectsEnabled.

## Light
- `glow` radius (× setting, max 40) and colour. Unlisted CompGlower registered with the glow grid, re-registered as the creature moves. Always on, discovered or not. Largest radius wins. Skipped on races with their own CompGlower.

## Materials
- Stuff on Hediff_Titan, saved, always in the name. SetMaterial / RollMaterial / GetMaterial / IsConstruct.
- Statue look; armour, melee damage, fire from the stuff (scaled by settings); construct body (no pain, blood, toxins, rot); butchering yields the stuff; market value StatPart.
- TitanMaterialExtension: allowRolling, forceAllowed, commonality, armorFactor, damageFactor, butcherYieldFactor, traits (granted, fromMaterial), tags.

## Harmony patches (12)
BestKindLabel postfix; DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear prefixes; MakeCorpse postfix; Corpse.IngestibleNow postfix; Pawn.ButcherProducts postfix; Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob postfix.

## Known limitations
- Info card shows hidden traits' numbers; hidden traits' abilities may show gizmos (Phase 3 step 2).
- Humanlike births don't inherit yet.
- Debug palette pins for our actions fail; don't pin them.

## Debug actions ("Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples + Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml): remove both together before publishing
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle, Irradiated (Uranium), Firebreather (Biotech; hidden; grants TF_Example_FireBreath, a fire spew copy with a 1-hour cooldown).
